title: Administrator / Legal Secretary Re-train Opportunity
description:
Job Title: Legal Secretary Re-train Opportunity

Location: Sharston, M22 4 SN

Salary: £28,000 Per annum

Job type: Full time, Permanent

Established in 2000, Express Solicitors is an award-winning, no win no fee law firm specialising exclusively in personal injury claims. Headquartered in Manchester, we support clients nationwide across all areas of personal injury, including employers' liability, serious injury, clinical negligence, occupiers' and public liability, road traffic accidents and industrial disease.

We are ranked 60th in The Lawyer UK Top 200, out of more than 10,000 law firms nationwide, and after achieving a 24% year-on-year growth, Express Solicitors are the largest personal injury claimant firm in the UK.

Our commitment to outstanding client care is reflected in our Trustpilot rating of 4.7 (Excellent), placing us among the highest-rated firms in the sector.

About The Role:

We are currently looking for strong administrators ideally with a minimum of two years administration experience. Background in legal and medical advantageous

Following extensive training you will be working in a pool of Legal Secretaries assisting a number of Lawyers. The job is varied with not just typing and file management, but preparing bundles, taking and making calls to clients, arranging meetings & conferences.

Responsibilities
- Working collaboratively within a pool of Legal Secretaries to support multiple Lawyers
- You will be working in one stream of work either Road Traffic Accidents, Employers' Liability or Occupiers & Public Liability.
- Preparing correspondence and legal documentation, including pleadings and court bundles
- Photocopying and scanning documents, with support from the Administration team where required
- Handling inbound and outbound telephone calls in a professional and courteous manner
- Scheduling appointments, arranging meetings, and liaising with Lawyers, clients, Counsel, and other stakeholders
- Providing support to fellow Legal Secretaries and the wider administration team as required
- Assisting with updates to the Proclaim case management system where appropriate

Person Specification:
- Demonstrable two years previous administration experience, background in legal and medical advantageous.
- Strong comprehension of English spelling, punctuation, and grammar.
- IT literate
- Exceptional customer service skills, including professional and friendly telephone manner.
- Acute attention to detail
- Ability to prioritise daily workload and experience of working in a fast-paced environment.
- Prior exposure to Proclaim case management system is desirable.
- Excellent word processing and audio typing skills
- Audio typing speed of 65+ words per minute
- Use of digital dictation, ideally Diktamen would be beneficial.

Salary & Hours
- A basic salary of up to £28,000
- Our standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:30pm Monday-Thursday and 8:30am to 5pm Friday.

Benefits:
- Hybrid Working - 3/2 hybrid working pattern after probation.
- 23 Days Holiday - Rising to 26 days, plus bank/public holidays.
- Extra Holidays - 3 holiday buy backs and an extra day for your birthday after service length requirement.
- Looking After Your Health - Private medical insurance available after 2 years' service, annual flu jab and Employee Assistance Programme.
- Looking After Your Well-being - 24/7 onsite Gym, Netball/Football team, 10km Manchester team and more.
- Work Life / Balance - Active social committee with generous departmental and firm-wide social budget.

Recruitment Process:

Interviews will be conducted by MS Teams and will include scenario-based questioning.

Our employees are our most important asset, we rate skill and ability above all else and our recruitment policy encourages applications from all.

Please click APPLY to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of; Legal Secretary, PA, Legal Typist, Typist, Legal PA, Secretary, Legal Administrator, Legal Office Support, Legal Assistant, Legal Business Support, Office Administrator, Business Support Admin Assistant may also be considered For This Role.

title: Commerical Paralegal in Manchester (Hybrid Working)
company: The Ten Percent Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
An opportunity has arisen for a Paralegal to join the in-house legal team at an educational establishment in central Manchester.

The role offers hybrid working, with two days per week working from home.

The position will involve providing legal and administrative support across intellectual property (IP) commercialisation, corporate transactions and commercial contracts. Responsibilities will include drafting and managing a range of legal documentation, including non-disclosure agreements, material transfer agreements, revenue share agreements and IP licence extensions and terminations. You will also assist with IP due diligence, reviewing contracts and funding agreements, identifying potential legal and contractual issues, preparing due diligence reports and maintaining accurate records.

Previous experience working in a legal role is essential, ideally with a commercial or intellectual property focus. You will have excellent attention to detail, strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and stakeholders. A degree in legal studies or a relevant legal qualification is desirable.

The role will be full-time, permanent and salary will be £30,000 per annum.

Full job description available on request

title: Costs Legal Secretary
description:
Job Title: Costs Legal Secretary

Location: Northenden, M22 4 HH

Salary: Up to £28,000 per annum, dependent on experience

Job type: Full time, Permanent

Established in 2000, Express Solicitors is an award-winning, no win no fee law firm specialising exclusively in personal injury claims. Headquartered in Manchester, we support clients nationwide across all areas of personal injury, including employers' liability, serious injury, clinical negligence, occupiers' and public liability, road traffic accidents and industrial disease.

About The Role:

You will play key role as an experienced Legal Secretary supporting the Costs Department in servicing the costs needs of the business. You will be required to work independently servicing volume instructions from a digital dictation platform, this will include the creation of letters, witness statements, bundling of exhibits, file notes and other court documents, including court bundles.

Many of the documents and communications required will be prepared in digital format using complimentary software. Some paper documents, for postal delivery, remain necessary.

Whilst this is a busy role, it is varied and rewarding. In addition to typing and file management, you will assist with consulting with clients, third parties and the Court regularly by telephone, assisting with printing jobs and from time to time may be required to organise meetings and conferences.

You will join a team of experienced assistants, and secretaries who will provide you with training and support as you transition into the role.

Responsibilities:
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to Partners, Associates, Costs Lawyers, Costs Negotiators, and other members of the Costs Team.
- Preparing, formatting, proofreading, and amending legal costs documents, preparing digital and paper bundles, correspondence, and court forms.
- Managing diaries, arranging meetings and appointments.
- Opening and closing client files in accordance with firm procedures and regulatory requirements.
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, barristers, court staff, and external stakeholders in a professional manner.
- Handling emails and telephone enquiries, ensuring matters are directed appropriately and dealt with promptly.
- Assisting with the preparation and filing of court documents, including electronic filing where required.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all case management systems and databases are updated.
- Organising and preparing bundles, exhibits, and supporting documentation for hearings, assessments, and negotiations.
- Monitoring key dates, court deadlines, and limitation periods.
- Audio typing of legal documents, correspondence and reports.
- Assisting with billing administration, file reviews, and matter management processes as required.
- Requesting and collating documents, records, invoices, and supporting evidence for costs claims and assessments.
- Ensuring compliance with firm policies, confidentiality requirements, data protection legislation, and court rules.
- Providing general administrative support including document scanning, photocopying, filing, archiving, and document management.
- Supporting the team with ad hoc projects and administrative tasks to ensure the efficient operation of our Legal Costs department.

Person Specification:
- Proven experience as a Legal Secretary in a busy team is essential
- Excellent written English skills, with strong spelling, punctuation, and grammar
- High level of IT literacy and confidence using modern office systems
- Outstanding client care skills, with a professional and friendly telephone manner
- Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail
- Ability to prioritise workload effectively and thrive in a fast-paced environment
- Previous experience using the Proclaim case management system is desirable but not essential
- Advanced word processing and audio typing skills
- Audio typing speed of 65+ words per minute
- Experience using digital dictation software, ideally Diktamen, would be advantageous

Salary & Hours
- Our standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:30pm Monday-Thursday and 8:30am to 5pm Friday.

Benefits:
- Hybrid Working - 3/2 hybrid working pattern after probation.
- 23 Days Holiday - Rising to 26 days, plus bank/public holidays.
- Extra Holidays - 3 holiday buy backs and an extra day for your birthday after service length requirement.
- Looking After Your Health - Private medical insurance available after 2 years' service, annual flu jab and Employee Assistance Programme.
- Looking After Your Well-being - 24/7 onsite Gym, Netball/Football team, 10km Manchester team and more.
- Work Life / Balance - Active social committee with generous departmental and firm-wide social budget.

Recruitment Process:

Interviews will be conducted by MS Teams and will include scenario-based questioning.

Our employees are our most important asset, we rate skill and ability above all else and our recruitment policy encourages applications from all.

Please click APPLY to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of; Legal Assistant, Legal Typist, Typist, Legal PA, Secretary, Legal Administrator, Legal Office Support, Legal Assistant, Legal Business Support, may also be considered for this role.

title: Housing Disrepair Fee Earner - Hybrid/Remote
description:
Housing Disrepair Fee Earner
Salary: £30,000 - £50,000 DOE
Location: Remote mostly, 1 day per week in Bolton

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a Housing Disrepair Solicitor, Fee Earner, Paralegal or Legal Assistant to join one of Manchester's fastest-growing specialist litigation firms.
This ambitious and highly regarded practice has quickly established an excellent reputation within the claimant litigation market and continues to experience significant growth.
Based in modern offices in the heart of Bolton, the firm offers an outstanding level of flexibility, requiring employees to attend the office just one day per week, with the remainder of the week worked remotely.
This is an excellent opportunity to join a genuinely supportive team where progression is encouraged, workloads are strong, and there are clear opportunities to develop your career as the department continues to expand.

The Role:
Case Management: Manage your own caseload of claimant Housing Disrepair matters from initial instruction through to settlement or trial, ensuring compliance with all procedural requirements and delivering excellent client care throughout.
Legal Drafting: Prepare letters of claim, pleadings, witness statements, court documents, schedules of loss, instructions to experts, and settlement documentation.
Evidence Gathering: Liaise with surveyors, medical experts, local authorities, housing associations, and other third parties to obtain evidence, assess liability, and progress claims efficiently.
Litigation & Negotiation: Conduct settlement negotiations, manage litigated matters, prepare trial bundles where required, and work proactively to achieve the best outcomes for clients.

The Individual:
Applications are welcomed from Legal Assistants, Paralegals, Fee Earners, Litigation Executives, Chartered Legal Executives and Solicitors.
Previous experience within Housing Disrepair is highly desirable.
Candidates with experience in claimant litigation or wider civil litigation who are looking to specialise will also be considered.
Confident managing your own workload, with the level of autonomy dependent upon your experience.
Strong drafting, organisational and communication skills.
Familiarity with the Civil Procedure Rules and case management systems such as Proclaim would be advantageous.
A proactive, client-focused approach with excellent attention to detail.

The Benefits:
Mostly remote working - only 1 day per week in the office.
Join a highly regarded, rapidly growing specialist litigation practice.
Open to candidates from Legal Assistant through to Senior Solicitor level.
High-quality caseload with excellent levels of work.
Genuine opportunities for rapid progression as the firm continues to expand.
Supportive leadership team and collaborative working environment.
Competitive salary based on experience.
Excellent long-term career prospects.

Apply:

title: Legal PA
description:
The Opportunity

A well-established professional services organisation is seeking an experienced and proactive Legal PA to join its support function. This role will provide dedicated administrative and PA support to 2-3 fee earners, working closely with them and business support colleagues to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the department.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organised individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced, client-facing environment and takes pride in delivering an exceptional level of support. The successful candidate will act as a central point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders, helping to coordinate administrative activities and ensuring the wider team can focus on delivering outstanding client service.

The organisation offers a collaborative and inclusive working environment where employees are encouraged to contribute ideas, develop professionally, and build strong working relationships across the business. Flexibility, teamwork, and a commitment to excellence are highly valued, with support available to help colleagues perform at their best.

Working alongside a friendly and professional team, you will play a key role in maintaining effective communication, managing priorities, and providing comprehensive administrative assistance across a range of business activities. This position would suit someone who can confidently manage multiple tasks, remain calm under pressure, and consistently demonstrate a high level of attention to detail.

The Role

In this role, you will:
- Deliver a professional and responsive service when handling client queries and requests via telephone, email, and written correspondence.
- Manage administrative processes relating to files and matters, including opening, maintaining, and closing records while ensuring compliance standards are met.
- Provide proactive support to senior stakeholders and wider team members, coordinating diaries, meetings, travel arrangements, accommodation bookings, and expense submissions.
- Assist with the end-to-end billing process, liaising with fee earners and finance teams to help ensure invoices are issued accurately and payments are received efficiently.
- Handle incoming and outgoing documentation promptly, ensuring all records and original documents are processed and stored correctly.
- Contribute to team projects, operational initiatives, and business development activities where required.
- Work closely with colleagues across different offices and departments to maintain a high standard of service and operational efficiency.

Working Pattern: Hybrid working arrangements available.

About You

To be successful in this position, you will have:
- Strong experience in an administrative, executive support, personal assistant, or legal support role.
- Prior exposure to a Real Estate or Property legal environment would be advantageous, although not essential.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including a professional and confident telephone manner.
- A collaborative approach and the ability to develop positive working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
- A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a willingness to take ownership of tasks and drive them through to completion.
- High levels of accuracy, attention to detail, and a methodical approach to your work.

This opportunity is ideally suited to an experienced Legal Secretary or career legal support professional with at least two years' relevant experience. Due to the nature of the role and the level of autonomy required, it is not intended as an entry-level position and is not suited to a recent graduate looking to pursue their SQE.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Part-Time Legal Secretary - Conveyancing
Experienced Legal Secretary looking for part-time hours that fit around your other commitments?
We're recruiting a Legal Secretary to support an established legal team in the Didsbury area. This opportunity would suit someone with a solid legal secretarial background who is confident preparing documents, supporting solicitors and keeping files and administrative tasks organised.
Previous conveyancing experience would be ideal, but it doesn't need to be your current area of work. If you've worked in conveyancing earlier in your career, or you're an experienced Legal Secretary in another area of law who is happy to get up to speed with conveyancing matters, we'd love to hear from you.
With pay of 14.50- 16.50 per hour, the option to work either two or three days per week and the possibility of the role becoming permanent, this could be a great opportunity for someone looking for part-time work within a professional legal environment.
What will you be doing as a Legal Secretary?
- Providing day-to-day secretarial support to solicitors and fee earners, helping them manage their workload efficiently
- Preparing legal documents, contracts, correspondence and other paperwork as required
- Maintaining client files and ensuring documents and records are accurate and up to date
- Supporting the administration of legal matters and helping keep cases progressing.
- Answering incoming calls, dealing with client enquiries and passing on messages where needed
- Covering reception, welcoming visitors and providing a professional first point of contact
- Assisting with general office administration and supporting colleagues across the team when required

What's in it for you?
- 14.50- 16.50 per hour, depending on experience
- Flexible part-time options: work two days per week, Monday and Tuesday, or add Friday to make it three days
- 14 hours per week minimum, with the option to work 21 hours
- Consistent working hours: 9am-5pm, with a one-hour lunch break
- Weekly pay and holiday pay during the temporary assignment
- Smart-casual dress code in a professional working environment
- Potential for a permanent position, depending on business requirements and suitability

Why would you join this company?
You'll be supporting an established legal team where good organisation, accurate administration and dependable secretarial support are valued.

The role offers a varied working day, combining legal secretarial responsibilities with client contact and general office support. With the choice of two or three working days, it's an opportunity to continue using your legal experience while working a part-time schedule.
What we're looking for
What's essential:
- Previous experience working as a Legal Secretary within a law firm or legal environment
- Experience preparing documents, managing files and providing secretarial support to solicitors or fee earners
- Good IT skills, including confidence using Microsoft Word and other Microsoft Office applications
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- The ability to manage a varied workload and prioritise tasks effectively
- Professional communication skills when dealing with clients over the telephone and face-to-face
- Availability to work on Mondays and Tuesdays

What's helpful but not essential:
- Previous experience as a Conveyancing Legal Secretary
- Experience with residential property transactions and conveyancing documentation, whether recently or earlier in your career
- Experience in another area of law, with transferable legal secretarial skills and the confidence to learn new processes
- Previous reception or general office administration experience
- Availability to work Fridays as well, if you'd prefer three days per week

You don't need to be working in conveyancing right now. We're keen to hear from experienced Legal Secretaries who have conveyancing knowledge from earlier in their career, as well as those currently supporting solicitors in other areas of law. The key is having a solid legal secretarial background and being available on Mondays and Tuesdays.
The Essentials
Salary: 14.50- 16.50 per hour, depending on experience
Hours: Two days per week minimum (Monday and Tuesday), 9am-5pm, with a one-hour lunch break. The option to add Friday for three days per week
Working hours: 14 hours per week minimum, or 21 hours if working Monday, Tuesday and Friday
Location: Didsbury
Job type: Temporary, with the potential to become permanent
To Apply

If you're an experienced Legal Secretary looking for part-time hours and have a background in conveyancing or another area of law, we'd love to hear from you.
Send your CV today to apply!

Apply now by sending your CV. We aim to respond to all successful applications within 2 days. If you haven't been contacted within 2 days your application has been unsuccessful. Please check our website and apply directly for any other suitable positions you see. We apologise that we are unable to contact everyone in person and thank you for your interest.
